item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00370","decision":"none","candidate_ranking":["C02","C18","C01"],"selected_candidate_label":null,"confidence":0.9,"relationship_type":"none","rationale":"C02 is the closest because it regulates conflicts between governmental duties and private interests and restricts outside compensation for specially appointed defense personnel. C18 likewise addresses outside-government reservists and conflict-of-interest statutes, while C01 concerns standards of conduct and agency-head implementation. None, however, shares the child's distinctive appearance-of-impropriety criteria, its sequence of prohibitions on fees and compensated speaking or writing, or its enumerated exceptions. The overlaps are thematic or routine administrative mechanisms rather than concrete evidence of a material drafting template.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"No such official shall engage in any outside employment or other outside activity not compatible with the full and proper discharge of the responsibilities of his office or position.","parent_excerpt":"the head of the department or agency involved shall take steps to avoid, to as great an extent as possible, any conflict between the governmental duties and the private interests of such personnel.","explanation":"C02 shares a substantive concern with conflicts between official duties and private interests, but its wording and operative scheme are materially different."},{"child_excerpt":"No such official shall receive compensation or anything of monetary value, other than that to which he is duly entitled from the Government","parent_excerpt":"Exemption hereunder shall not extend to the receipt or payment of salary in connection with the appointee's Government service hereunder from any source other than the private employer of the appointee","explanation":"C02 also regulates outside payment, but only within a specialized statutory exemption for defense appointees; it does not reproduce the child's general ethics rule or its associated exceptions."},{"child_excerpt":"Each department and agency head shall review or issue internal directives appropriate to his department or agency to assure the maintenance of high ethical and moral standards therein.","parent_excerpt":"The head of each department and agency of the Government shall be responsible for establishing and maintaining within his department or agency an effective program","explanation":"C01 uses similar decentralized agency-head implementation, but this is routine administrative machinery and concerns employee security rather than ethical standards."}]}
